name: Iwahashi Shunpei
source:
Main protagonist in [url=/c79642]Kotomi's[/url] scenario.

A college student who wants to open a clinic; though he's not a medical student, his father's a doctor at the local university hospital, so he's looking for a job through his connections. He's a bit of a womanizer due to his mother dying when he was young, and he loves seeing women be jealous over him.
